projects.name: Female Literacy and Opportunities for Work (FLOW)
projects.description: The Female Literacy and Opportunities for Work (FLOW) Project aims to improve the socio-economic status of vulnerable women through literacy education and livelihood support interventions. Many women participating in literacy circles face challenges related to food insecurity, limited income opportunities, and inadequate access to agricultural inputs and technical knowledge. To address these challenges, the project will implement a home farming initiative targeting women enrolled in literacy circles in Khartoum State.

projects.name: Strengthening community engagement and empowerment in Darfur (SCEED) and climate adaptation
projects.description:
SCEED  is a four-year project building small farmers' resilience through:
• Building farmers' capacities with modern farming techniques using the FFS Approach.
• Boosting farmers' marketing techniques through the FMS Approach.
• Providing market-driven training and skills.
• Providing life-saving assistance through MPCA.
• Linking farmers with the early warning system and weather forecast

projects.name: Sustainable Agriculture and Livelihood for Women And Girls in Sudan (SALWA)
projects.description: The Sustainable Agriculture and Livelihood for Women and Girls in Sudan (SALWA) project strengthens the livelihoods of over 27,500 people in conflict-affected Blue Nile, West Darfur, and North Darfur, prioritizing women-headed households, youth, and marginalized groups. Through improved seed access, financial inclusion, climate-smart agriculture, and gender equality, the project promotes resilience, self-reliance, and sustainable economic empowerment.

projects.description: This action is strategically designed to address the humanitarian and economic fallout of the conflict by focusing on the protection and economic empowerment of Sudan's youth.

projects.name: H.E.R (Hope Empowerment Resilience)
projects.description: The project is a two-year action implemented by a consortium of 3 partners – Zenab, MTI and DRC – with DRC as the consortium lead. The project integrates health, nutrition, livelihoods, protection and GBV and will target 3 localities of Al Fashaga (Um Gargour refugee camp), Galabat Gharabiya (Al Huri and Sabone) and Galabat Sharqiah (Rashid and Hamra)
